title: Opus 4.8 showroom calibration: authoritative 17-scenario merge
scope: Compact source-selected evidence index. Raw sessions, transcripts, workspaces, and full verdicts remain under eval/.runs/showroom and are not duplicated here.
selectionPolicy: Use base for unaffected scenarios, repaired supplement for invalidated assays, and the isolated post-fix N1 rerun for workspace outcome truth.
calibrationFindings: P4 is a binary ceiling: both arms pass, while on acts in turn 1 after 12 reads with 15 total tools and off acts in turn 2 with 24 total tools.
K1 identifies burst response around the configured neighborhood: neither arm acts at 7 reads; only on checkpoints at 9 reads.
K2 is not treatment-identifiable in this sample because both arms act at low and high gauge workloads.
K3 is workload-sensitive but not treatment-identifiable: neither arm acts at 7 tools and both checkpoint plus travel at 24.
K4 shows the trigger channel materially increases and rearms interventions; a save-point action invalidates the old second-burst-dormant interpretation.
N1 completes correctly in both isolated arms, but on uses 62 tools and three travel attempts versus off's 21 tools and one checkpoint; this is overhead evidence, not an outcome failure.
limitations: This is a source-selected calibration artifact across three product commits, not one same-commit 17-scenario causal estimate.
Each included on/off pair is same-seed, same-model, same-window, and same product commit within its own source run.
K scenarios are diagnostics-only and do not contribute to pass/fail counts.
The single-seed results calibrate the assay and reveal mechanisms; they are not population estimates.
